notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
[b]- 2 New Towers[/b]
Hot Air Balloon and Big Hammer Towers are added to the game. Both having their unique behaviors. More to come
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44363503/173ca239189980430aa84caed3fec260aac8c259.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44363503/efdf900f734558760172967a0321ed960041955d.png[/img]

[b]- 2 New Maps[/b]
As the name implies, 2 new maps have also been added, way more to come
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44363503/defbd79d86fb70ae4da3f4ac8c54552bc023b489.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44363503/f74b7771c8cb1da78161e56a2111b34ba528c4ae.png[/img]

[b]- Challenging attributes added to maps[/b]
Further maps have neat little challenges built into them. We'll allow user customization for those and similar challenges from next update.

[b]- Multiple Quality of life changes[/b]
Like a few better sounds, responsive actions, action feedback etc. Just makes the game feel better and alive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44363503/5a516d3526110fa9c1668fa6247e24b38f002386.png[/img]

[b]- Major Optimizations (for end game and also for mobile devices)[/b]
Optimization is much improved even in the early game. One major bad GPU practice removed, and also CPU sided improvements in code.

[b]- Bug Fixes[/b]
All bugs squashed except ladybug

[list]
[*] Patched Hextower so it attacks invis enemys.
[*] Some balancing changes
[/list]
